mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% over the next month, investors anticipate higher future inflation, which reduces equity discount rates and drives positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the identified FEDFUNDS rise, or inflation (CPIAUCSL) does not rise in parallel.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment) above the prior month's level, accompanied by UNRATE falling below 5%, signals labor market strengthening that supports equity valuations and yields positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or insignificant, or employment growth decelerates while unemployment remains low.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (real GDP) exceeds INDPRO (industrial production) by at least 2% in the prior quarter, it indicates robust consumer and business demand, which predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > INDPRO by ≥2% in previous quarter
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative or statistically insignificant, or the GDP/industrial production gap reverses direction.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of at least 3% for two consecutive months predicts supply-side weakness that elevates risk premia and produces negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by ≥3% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or not statistically significant, or INDPRO recovers in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% for three consecutive months, it suggests a patient policy that lowers real rates, supporting equity valuations and generating positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or flat, or FEDFUNDS rises before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 4% followed by a monthly rise in PAYEMS above 140,000 suggests improving labor market conditions that boost investor confidence and drive positive 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% AND PAYEMS > 140000 in the following month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not positive, or unemployment does not improve as predicted.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (housing starts) falls by more than 10% in the prior quarter, it indicates cooling construction activity and reduced economic momentum, which typically precedes negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases by >10% in previous quarter
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05), or HOUST recovers quickly.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in both INDPRO and RSAFS (retail sales) by at least 5% in the prior month signals dual supply-side weakness that amplifies market uncertainty and drives negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month by ≥5% AND RSAFS < previous month by ≥5%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or not statistically significant, or either series recovers before the horizon.
